result.topic_en: Calculations with p-variable theta functions with half-integer characteristics: the shift formula relating a characteristic theta function to the ordinary theta function, a reduction of the period matrix, and the behaviour of characteristics under a linear (symplectic) transformation of the periods, ending with invariance of the parity sum ε_ν ε'_ν mod 2.

methods.what: Definition of the p-variable Riemann theta function
methods.quote: $\vartheta(v_1, v_2 \cdots v_p) = \left(\sum_{-\infty}^{\infty}\right)^p e^{\left(\sum_1^p\right)^2 a_{\mu,\mu'} m_\mu m_{\mu'} + 2\sum_1^p v_\mu m_\mu}$

methods.what: Theta function with half-integer characteristic expressed as a shifted ordinary theta function times an exponential factor
Elimination of v_p (reduction of the period matrix) and transformation of characteristics under change of variables v_p+v_1
Invariance of the bilinear form under linear (symplectic) transformation of periods
Transformation law of characteristics mod 2 under a period transformation
Parity (even/odd) of a characteristic is invariant under transformation
